newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 6.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on May 6:
WASHINGTON - America Online Inc. earned $2.6 million in the quarter ended March 31, the first full quarter since the nation's largest computer online service switched to flat-rate pricing.
WASHINGTON - James River Corp., a household paper products manufacturer, said it will acquire papermaker Fort Howard Corp. for $3.4 billion in stock.
WASHINGTON - American Airlines pilots approved a new five-year contract brokered by the White House, ending the threat of a strike against the nation's second-largest airline.
WASHINGTON - The Federal Trade Commission has drafted a new set of guidelines that would expand the type of merchandise able to carry the "Made in USA" label.
